@@leveling4@@{{{leveling4}}}@@leveling5@@{{{leveling5}}}@@leveling6@@{{{leveling6}}}@@range@@{{{range}}}@@radius@@{{{radius}}}@@effectradius@@[[File:Range center.png|20px|link=Range|An icon representing the keyword Centered range]] 325 • 650@@width@@{{{width}}}@@speed@@{{{speed}}}@@casttime@@none@@cost@@50 / 55 / 60 / 65 / 70@@cooldown@@12 / 11.5 / 11 / 10.5 / 10@@targeting@@Direction@@damagetype@@Physical@@spellshield@@true@@projectile@@False@@notes@@ * '''Camille''' can move during the delay, but the hitbox and '''Camille's''' visuals are fixed to the initial target direction. ** '''Camille's''' facing-direction, for effects such as [[File:Cassiopeia Petrifying Gaze.png|20xpx|border|link=Cassiopeia#Petrifying Gaze|An icon for Cassiopeia's ability Petrifying Gaze]] [[Cassiopeia#Petrifying Gaze|Petrifying Gaze]], is the direction she is moving, and not the direction the model is facing. * The damage modifier against non-epic monsters applies after the cap. * Because the increased damage in the outer range of the cone is dealt as an '''additional''' instance of damage (as opposed to '''bonus''' damage to the original instance), it will trigger effects twice such as being reduced by [[File:Bone Plating rune.png|20xpx|link=Bone Plating|An icon representing Bone Plating]] [[Bone Plating]] an extra time.(unexpected) ** It still belongs to the same [[:Champion ability|cast instance]], therefore it does not trigger additional stacks of [[File:Conqueror rune.png|20xpx|link=Conqueror|An icon representing Conqueror]] [[Conqueror]] or [[File:Electrocute rune.png|20xpx|link=Electrocute|An icon representing Electrocute]] [[Electrocute]].@@
